seating.method: Median of64 standard-DEM samples at54m radius plus0.15m; translates the main architecture without rescaling. Coarse DEM under the hall is elevated relative to its perimeter.
seating.northMethod: Median of7 courtyard standard-DEM samples plus0.20m.

vaultSeating.basis: Median of16 standard retained DEM courtyard samples at27m radius plus0.15m. No separate terrain source or survey.

altarSeating.basis: Three1.7m rises,rail heights,gate heights,blue coping and stair profiles are picture-guided exterior estimates. No mapped altitude or surveyed dimensions are claimed for the altar. Ground seating is median16 retained standard DEM samples around32m radius plus0.15m.
altarSeating.previewMarginBasis: Observed coarse-grid terrain bleed at the outer paving/wall boundary. A20m source-local preview margin keeps the167m court clear of7.03m interpolation. Approximate preview seating only;whole-site host terrain replacement remains pending.

palaceSeating.basis: All palace heights are picture-guided estimates:main hall raised0.9m with walls to7.4m and green roof ridge12.5m;east gate wall7m/roof11.8m;ancillary roofs4.8–6.6m. No mapped height or surveyed threshold is claimed. Court grade is the median16 retained standard DEM building-center samples plus0.15m;moat surface is0.65m below that floor.

serviceSeating.basis: Each service cluster uses the median retained standard DEM height at its building centers plus0.15m. Flat court extents are visualization connections derived from neighboring hall footprints,not mapped paved-area claims. Preview terrain seating uses the retained source grid with an explicit20m interpolation margin;host terrain replacement and full precinct fit remain pending.

precinctSeating.method: Lower the existing review fixture beneath the new corridor, pavilion, gate foundations and causeway floor triangles with a12m interpolation margin. Retain the raw standard DEM unchanged. This prevents source-preview terrain intersections;host ground replacement still requires full-site review.
